static_traits.name: An Yu
static_traits.educational_background: Currently studying for a bachelor's degree
static_traits.social_status: 有一位要好的朋友，但尚not yet与他人分享学业困扰
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往心理治疗或精神卫生就诊经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑尚可，愿意合作，频繁出现消极Automatic thoughts与灾难化推断；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我最近数学考试not及格，这让我overwhelmed，总觉得因此我永远without法从Graduated from university。
basic_info.core_demands: Fear and negative thoughts have begun to affect my daily functioning and mental health, so I hope to resolve these problems through counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough，会让家人失望

special_situations.event: 收到数学考试not及格的成绩
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failing one exam意味着我将一直失败、without法毕业
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately doubling study and considering hiring a tutor, trying to quickly recover grades

special_situations.event: When thinking of academic prospects and upcoming exams
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能在not yet来所有考试中取得好成绩，就说明I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids deep thinking and planning; easily distracted and procrastinates when studying
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会一直失败，考试都会not及格。

special_situations.event: Situations of talking with family or classmates about exams and grades
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果成绩not好，就会让家人失望，说明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 疏离朋友和家人、Reduced socializing以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I disappointed my family，他们会看not起我。

special_situations.event: 独Self-study习其他科目时not断回想那次失败
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only achieving perfect grades counts as qualified; otherwise it is complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated self-criticism, compulsive intensified study yet hard to sustain focus
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果这次也学not好，就证明我彻底失败。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain family approval and acceptance through academic success
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败会导致被家人失望与negate，从而失去价值感
defense_goal: 通过疏离与not分享感受来避免面对他人的失望评价；通过加倍Learning与问题解决来维持掌控感、降低Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: A potential failure who would disappoint family
object_relations.object_representation: Family/others with high expectations who may be disappointed and critical

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes trying new strategies (such as hiring a tutor, joining a study group) and invites them to act
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向将任何尝试与not yet来的彻底失败相连，认为一旦not奏效就证明自己not行
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和、具体的语气承认其担忧，邀请其将“大失败”改为“小实验”，use逐步计划与可检验目标，减少评判性语言。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to tell friends or family about feelings and stress and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes expressing needs will burden others, so I must press my own needs down
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 强调互助与关系的双向性，用Empathy语气正常化“求助”行为，鼓励小步尝试分享一件具体且可承受的困扰。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about exam grades and graduation prospects
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将结果视为全好或全坏，将一次失败等同于彻底destruction前途
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用温和的现实检验，Guidance其识do not灰度与中间地带，use具体数据与阶段性目标来对冲“全或without”认知。

manifestations: Alienates friends and family due to stress and feelings of failure
not yet与他人分享学业担忧，Worried about burdening others
Interprets one failure as a ruined future, losing hope about graduating

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“我not该麻烦do not人”的自我Demands
将“必须not能失败”当作硬性规则

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive worry about disappointing family, harsh on oneself
因担忧被评判而Reduced socializing与求助

positive_force: Willing to seek help (tries asking classmates for help, considers hiring a tutor and study groups)
Has a degree of willingness to solve problems; willing to cooperate in making plans and trying small goals
Has one close friend; potential social support can be mobilized
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent，倾向过度概括与预测最坏结果
Strong fear of failure and worry about disappointing family
Sleep and diet disturbance，进一步削弱专注与Learning动机

target_behavior.behavior: 学业相关的Anxiety与灾难化Automatic thoughts（如“我永远without法毕业”）
antecedent: 收到数学考试not及格的成绩
When thinking of academic prospects and upcoming exams
target_behavior.core_reason: Strong fear of failure and catastrophizing cognitions (one failure equals a ruined future and disappointing the family)
target_behavior.function: 逃避Anticipation的失败与羞耻感，试图通过控制与警觉来降低not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: 注意力困难、LearningDecreased motivation、Sleep and diet disturbance，整体学业Performance declining further

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance（疏离朋友与家人、减少交流）
antecedent: Being asked about exams and grades
Thinking about sharing academic troubles with others or seeking support
target_behavior.core_reason: not想成为他人的负担、害怕被他人失望或评判
target_behavior.function: 避免负性评价与not适情绪，暂时降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Increased sense of isolation、Reduced social support，Anxiety与without助感加重
